title: Mitosis non-stop shipping architecture (CI-to-green + blocked-MSP continuation)

completion_criteria.text: A dedicated Fable audit returns a flaw inventory of the current mitosis merge/PR-open gating with file:line citations, confirming or refuting the 7 findings from the 2026-07-27 review
Industry-standard research (merge queues, stacked PRs, CI auto-remediation, build-ahead schedulers) returns cited, verified findings
An improved architecture is specified that resolves the stop conditions and is demonstrably SIMPLER and MORE ROBUST than the current design, not merely more capable
The architecture specifies how mitosis drives a shipped MSP's CI/CD to green automatically (detect red, diagnose, fix, re-push, re-verify) with a bounded, non-looping failure path
The architecture specifies how mitosis continues into blocked MSPs while a parent PR is open for human review, without terminating the run
The user explicitly approves the architecture spec before any implementation begins

spine.active_goal: Implement the APPROVED quiescent-advance architecture (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-28-mitosis-quiescent-advance.md, the authority). A run must never stop dead at a human review boundary, must drive a shipped MSP's red CI back to green within a bounded path, and must resume from ANY clone via one idempotent command. Preflight on 2026-07-28 found four blockers that must clear before dispatch.
spine.next_step: Asks (a)/(b)/(c) CLOSED by 0085/0086/0087, so M0/M4/M8 are now IN SCOPE; landing order is M0 -> M1 -> M2 -> M6 -> M3 -> M5 -> M4 -> M7 -> M8. open_risks: NEW/BLOCKING: the suite is not hermetic - it resolves against the ambient ~/.claude install and its own checkout path. Proven: protect-claude-config.test.mjs passes 9/9 canonical, fails 2/9 in a worktree at the SAME commit. Mitosis verifies in worktrees, so green is unverifiable.
Spec §11's baseline is wrong. Measured origin/main @ beca874 = 1540 tests / 1520 pass / 20 fail, not '1415 pass / 0 fail'. Correct it during re-grounding; do not carry the old figure forward.

EVERY :line cite is stale: grounded at 450804e (4847 lines), origin/main is 4920. Mapping NOT produced this session. M3/M5 are deletion MSPs under the mirror-guard byte-identity rule, so a wrong cite deletes the wrong block twice.

mitosis.js INLINES lib copies (window.mjs, reconcile.mjs). Every M3/M4/M7 deletion must land TWICE in one commit. Guard is tests/mirror-guard.test.mjs, NOT .drift-state.json (a SessionStart cache that never runs in CI).
Section 8's count is -8, not -9, deliberately; the reconciliation note in §8 explains why and must survive edits. Do not 'correct' it back.

M6 publishes refs/mitosis/RUNID/manifest. Its identity-only, write-once rule is the invariant behind 3.1's single authority. Smuggling status into that ref regresses to the four-disagreeing-reconstructions problem.

M0 is now AUTHORIZED by 0085 but still UNFIXED: applyBuiltTransition never clears resumePoint, so a rebuilt plan-parked unit keeps stage:'plan' and the guard blocks the git-ref rescue. Red test first. Sits behind hermeticity, since red-then-green needs a trustworthy signal.

K=8 is CONFIRMED by 0086, but the instrumentation debt is NOT discharged: M4 still owes the per-run divergence and rebuild-unit counts. If that number is material, K becomes adaptive again - with data next time.
Class 6 is CONFIRMED file-level by 0087, stricter than 0067's line-level. 0067 is NOT superseded; it is implemented more conservatively. Do not silently relax it back to line granularity later.

Fact derivation puts the forge on the hot path. An outage must degrade to 'cannot advance, exit quiescent, say why', never to a wrong 'failed'. The manifest ref shares this exposure and degrades to identity: local-only.
Section 12 risk 1 is the honest weak point: a quiescent run advances only when a human next acts. M5 owes the wall-clock instrumentation so it is measured, not assumed.
§13 of the spec still reads asks (a)/(b)/(c) as OPEN. The spec file is stale against 0085/0086/0087 and must be updated in the same pass that re-grounds the cites.
out_of_scope: Any out-of-process or forge-side invoker. Ruled CLOSED by 0076 at user instruction - not deferred, not future work. Do not reintroduce it.
Agent-performed merges. Every merge to any shared branch stays human-gated. The three callers may open PRs and push; they never merge.

Unattended relaunch with no human in the session - rejected in 0069 as a trust-model change.
Writing analysis to .claude/reports/ - it is git-TRACKED and carries an unresolved leak caveat. Keep findings in the ledger, which is not tracked.
